business_problem: Kingsoft Office wanted to launch a domestic AI office product quickly, but needed a Chinese-first large-model stack, strong content-safety controls and an operating model for continuously tuning prompts and training data across office scenarios.
solution_summary: Kingsoft Office connected WPS AI to Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan model platform to create a broad document- and presentation-assistance layer across WPS Office and WPS 365. The technical pattern is a multi-loop operating model rather than a simple API connection. First, an AI-technology middle layer handles large-model API integration, parameters, error codes and quality monitoring. On top of that, prompt engineering defines roles, instruction scopes and chain-of-thought patterns that adapt the model to office tasks. A second loop uses labeled bad cases and SFT data from text, slides and spreadsheets to keep improving output quality. Together those inner and outer loops let Kingsoft co-build and tune office scenarios such as drafting, rewriting, summarizing, polishing, translation and PPT generation, while Qianfan's content-safety controls form a safety boundary around production use. The result is a model-driven office copilot that serves multiple file types and creation stages rather than a single feature.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model infrastructure behind WPS AI's writing and presentation features.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages the office-assistant experiences across WPS products.

solution_components.name: WPS AI
solution_components.role: Delivers user-facing drafting, rewriting, summarization and PPT-generation capabilities.

solution_components.name: Prompt Engineering Loop
solution_components.role: Continuously tunes instructions and data to improve office-task quality and safety.

data_flow: User document, slide and spreadsheet requests flow through WPS AI into the Qianfan model stack, where prompt engineering and labeled training data optimize generation quality before results are returned to office applications.
business_outcome: Kingsoft launched a domestic AI office assistant that covers multiple content formats, improves user productivity and created an iterative quality-and-safety operating model around office AI.
metrics: WPS AI addresses more than 30 common office needs.
